mapper.sql: case when exists (select 1 from friend_relations fr where fr.user_id = least(#{userId}, u.id) and fr.friend_id = greatest(#{userId}, u.id)) then 'FRIEND' when exists (select 1 from friend_requests r where r.from_user_id = #{userId} and r.to_user_id = u.id and r.status = 0) then 'REQUEST_SENT' when exists (select 1 from friend_requests r where r.from_user_id = u.id and r.to_user_id = #{userId} and r.status = 0) then 'REQUEST_RECEIVED' when exists (select 1 from user_blocks ub where (ub.blocker_id = #{userId} and ub.blocked_id = u.id) or (ub.blocked_id = #{userId} and ub.blocker_id = u.id)) then 'BLOCKED' else 'NONE' end as relation
mapper.select: select count(*) from users u where u.id <> #{userId} and (u.username like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or u.nickname like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
